headline: Approved the Assistant Library Director's contract with grammatical edits, 5-0; discussed FY27 budget, MAR waiver, and trust fund spending.
summary: The director reported that the FY27 budget is on track, but the city did not meet the Municipal Appropriation Requirement, so the library will apply for a waiver. Library hours were reduced starting July 1, and the Farms branch now has 33 open hours per week. The board also approved the Assistant Library Director's contract and discussed trust fund spending for FY27.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 30, 2026 meeting, 6-0.
Approved the minutes of the August 13, 2026 meeting, 6-0.
Approved the contract of the Assistant Library Director, with grammatical edits, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Colleen Michaels made a motion, seconded by Mary Behrle, to accept the minutes of the meeting of June 30, 2026. Motion passed 6-0.
Colleen Michaels made a motion, seconded by Margaret Altman, to accept the minutes of the meeting of August 13, 2026. Motion passed 6-0.
Mary Behrle made a motion, seconded by Colleen Michaels, to approve the contract of the Assistant Library Director, with grammatical edits. Motion passed 5-0.
